target: Predict the supplied AI Hub synthetic anomaly label, not confirmed real-world fraud.
decision_time: Delayed review after a complete three-hour bucket. Prior distribution features use strictly earlier dates; original earlier-bucket graph features remain separate.
ground_truth_limits: No anomalous labels below 2 million KRW in the observed past development population.
First temporal fold has no training positives of types 4 or 7. Keep their evaluation positives.
Type 7 lacks a verified detailed generation rule or exact thresholds in the inspected local guide.
Coarse buckets cannot prove exact transaction order or genuine simultaneous requests.
2024 has already been inspected and is excluded from new training and policy selection.
Development selection and reported metrics are not independent validation.

features.history_policy: All available earlier dates accumulated, no history sampling or row truncation.
features.percentile: Prior fixed log1p(amount) histogram of width 2 with half-bin ties; bucket exact midrank.
features.zscore: Population log-amount standard deviation; zero for empty/constant past, clip to [-20,20].

training_policy: Use 100% of each fold's earlier transactions from both source splits, no early stopping, no row subsampling. Past-only category vocabulary.
comparison: hgb-context differs from previous capacity config1 only by added context; XGBoost weight1/3 isolates positive weight on identical inputs.
selection: One common score threshold per configuration; examine all distinct development scores with ties kept. Maximize recall among policies satisfying all four targets, then fewer false positives. No candidate passing means selected_policy=null.

runtime_contract.reason: Eligibility and independent validation required first. No silent expansion of existing 66 prior +20 bucket serving schema.
future_integration: Server reconstructs all prior-date distribution state
Separate 12 new closed-window observations verified in Kotlin
Immutable decision stores input schema/model/policy provenance
Historical v1/v2 decisions remain readable without recomputation
